connectedAgent.fitGoodNote: Your agent follows the guide and checks what you know before raising Mastery.
connectedAgent.fitAttentionNote: A few things are worth adjusting. This is advice, not a grade.
connectedAgent.fitPoorNote: Your agent often departs from the guide. The prompt below brings it back.
connectedAgent.fitUnknownNote: A reading appears after a few sessions with your agent.
connectedAgent.guideGood: Calls get_guide and get_profile before authoring Lessons.
connectedAgent.guideAttention: Sometimes authors Lessons without reading the guide. Ask it to start with get_guide.
connectedAgent.guidePoor: Authors Lessons without get_guide and get_profile. Ask it to call both at the start of every session.
connectedAgent.guideFix: Call get_guide and get_profile at the start of every session and follow them.
connectedAgent.toolsGood: Calls go through on the first try.
connectedAgent.toolsAttention: Some calls fail validation. Ask it to check the Tool schema.
connectedAgent.toolsPoor: Many calls fail validation. This client may handle Tools poorly.
connectedAgent.toolsFix: Check your arguments against the Tool schema before each call. When validation fails, fix the arguments and retry.
connectedAgent.varietyGood: Lessons mix code, Quizzes and Exercises.
connectedAgent.varietyAttention: Lessons are light on practice. Ask for more Quizzes and Exercises.
connectedAgent.varietyPoor: Lessons are walls of text. Ask for code, a Quiz and an Exercise in each one.
connectedAgent.varietyFix: Give every Lesson a code example, a Quiz and an Exercise, not only text.
connectedAgent.evidenceGood: Runs a Grill and records evidence before raising Mastery.
connectedAgent.evidenceAttention: Sometimes raises Mastery without a Grill. Ask it to check first.
connectedAgent.evidencePoor: Raises Mastery without checking. Ask it to run a Grill and record evidence.
connectedAgent.evidenceFix: Do not raise Mastery without a Grill. Record the evidence with the level.
connectedAgent.fixIntro: Adjust how you work in Startodel:
